compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from a language learning app called "ChineseSkill." The main contents and functions of this screen are organized into three main tabs at the top: "LEARN," "REVIEW," and "DISCOVER." The current tab displayed is "LEARN."

Under the "LEARN" tab, there are various categories for learning Chinese, each represented by an icon and a label. The categories include:

1. Basics 1
2. Basics 2
3. Basics 3
4. Color
5. Number & Measure
6. Food
7. Shape
8. Nature
9. Negation
10. Question
11. Time
12. Tense

Each category likely contains lessons and exercises related to the specific topic to help users learn and practice Chinese vocabulary and grammar.
